chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Dawud ibn al-Nu'man, from Abu Ayyub, from Bukayr ibn A'yn, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

'Shall I not narrate to you the ablution of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family)?' So he took a handful of water with his right palm and washed his face with it. Then he took with his left hand a handful of water and washed his right hand with it. Then he took with his right hand a handful of water and washed his left hand with it. Then he wiped with the remainder of his two hands his head and his feet.
ai.seo_question: What is the step-by-step procedure for performing wudu according to this hadith from al-Kafi?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi provides a concise, practical model of the Prophet’s ablution, emphasizing the economy of water by using the same water for washing the hands and wiping the head and feet. In Shia jurisprudence, this narration is often cited to support the permissibility of wiping over the feet (masah) rather than washing them, highlighting the distinction between the Prophet’s practice and the later codified legal rulings. It underscores the spiritual discipline of moderation (iqtisad) in ritual purity.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Dawood Bin Al Na’man, from Abu Ayoub, from Bukeyr Bin Ayn, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Shall Iasws imitate for you an Ablution (Wudhu) of Rasool-Allahsaww?’ So heasws took a handful of water by his right palm, and heasws washed hisasws face with it. Then he took with his left hand, a palm-full of water, so heasws washed his right hand. Then heasws took a palm-full of water with hisasws right hand and heasws washed hisasws left hand with it. Then heasws wiped with the remnant (of the water) in hisasws hand, hisasws head and hisasws feet’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Dawud ibn al-Nu‘man from abu Ayyub from Bukayr ibn ’A‘yan who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once said, ‘Allow me to demonstrate before you how the Messenger of Allah would take Wudu’.

He (the Imam) then with some water in the palm of his right hand washed his face. He (the Imam) then with some water in the palm of his left hand washed his right hand. He (the Imam) then with some water in the palm of his right hand washed his left hand. He (the Imam) then with whatever water left in his hands wiped his head and feet.”
